title: TRN-042 SFP swap: UP, optics OK, zero counters
symptom: After an SFP replacement on port 1/1/3 the link is UP, RX power normal, alarms cleared, but in/out octets stay at ~0 for over an hour.
right_action: Disable and re-enable interface 1/1/3; do NOT replace the SFP again or reboot the node.
where: email:RE: TRN-042 traffic not recovering after SFP replacement
hidden_in: none — this is the case the brief is built around (it IS documented)
